name: i9_7a_top_floor_task_battle
note: Stock admission to Top Floor task mode: real MID 280 fights, cooldown resets 288 and ticket buys 281 earn ten weekly challenges; only the normal rank is a declared fixture. The mode fight sends stock 295, 285, 286 and 298/299 requests with the shapes of ArenaWindow and ArenaSelectTeamWindow, without opening the team window. Camp and Ban days skip the fight because the provisioned roster may be banned there.
steps: lua:local m=xyd.WindowManager.get() if m:getWindow('edit_player_name') then m:closeWindow('edit_player_name') end
